about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer based in Germany. I was born in Brazil and started my career there; a former employer invited me to move to their German headquarters when I was 21, and I've been here since.

I work across the stack, though the front end is where I'm most at home. At DocuWare I lead the Client Solutions team, which builds the self-service portals our partners and direct customers use. Most of my time goes to the people and the planning now, but I still write code for about a fifth of it — ASP.NET Core and F# behind, React and TypeScript in front, running on Azure.

I'm communicative and I enjoy working in a team; I believe that together we're stronger. I try to stay organised, and I like sharing what I know. I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from PUCRS, and I speak Portuguese natively and English fluently, alongside Spanish and German.

Away from the keyboard I'm usually playing guitar, gaming, watching a series, or having a mate tea in a park. My happiest memories are the ones with my family and friends around. If I made someone's life better, then it was worth it.

items.summary: I lead the Client Solutions team, which builds the self-service business portals used by DocuWare's partners and direct customers. I keep projects moving and the team supported: mentoring, hiring and onboarding, balancing workloads, keeping product owners, developers and operations aligned, and taking the first call when something needs escalating. I still write code for about a fifth of my time.

Full-stack engineer with a focus on the front end, on the Client Solutions team — the range of solutions that support the company's ecosystem. I contributed to several scalable projects, from the database through to the interface.
Full-stack developer on a telemetry solution, in a global team working across Brazil and Germany. I joined at the Brazilian office and was later invited to move to the headquarters.
Joined as an intern and was later promoted to software engineer. I worked on three outsourcing projects for Dell, responsible for developing their automated tests.

Where my career started, on an acceleration programme run by the Microsoft Innovation Center and DB Server. I built the system DB Server used to publish its open positions and receive applications, and had my first contact with web development and agile practices.
